name: URY landscape kiosk cart
describe: Full-screen cart under the repeated kiosk header: CartPage with a bordered "← Back to menu" button, centred "Your Cart" title, bordered line cards with round −/+ steppers, then the item count, total and a full-width "Proceed to checkout" button.

The kiosk passes className="h-full", which drops CartPage's flex-col, so the footer follows the list instead of sitting at the bottom (faithful to the source). Text uses the shared screen's text-sm at kiosk size. Fixed UI labels are author translations for RTL (the self-order app has no locale file) and NEED NATIVE REVIEW; RTL is a kit extension.
